before.title: VEYMENZ Bacteriostatic Gel
before.descriptionHtml:
An intimate-care gel with a light, clear texture, presented in individually packaged, single-use applicators.

Net content: 3 g × 7

Precautions

Do not use on broken mucosa, during menstruation or pregnancy. This is not medicine and cannot be used to treat medical conditions. Keep clean before and after use. Discontinue use and consult a specialist if discomfort occurs. Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight and high heat.
